manifest.name: dsh-usage-replay
manifest.description: Cross-session per-model token usage for DeepSeek Harness: replays every persisted session log (multi-frame zstd) and aggregates provider-reported usage by model, day and workspace — a usage panel tab, a per-conversation per-model popover, and two local read-only HTTP routes. Tokens only, no cost estimates.
manifest.author: Eclipse-NotFound

bundle.text:
# dsh-usage-replay: cross-session per-model token usage panel.
#
# Replays every persisted session log under ~/.dsh/sessions (multi-frame
# zstd, same container as dsh-session-persistence-jsonl) and aggregates the
# provider-reported usage carried by assistant/message events, attributed to
# the provider/model of the most recent request/header envelope. Tokens only.
#
# Host half exposes GET /usage-replay/api/summary (same-origin, Host-header
# trust fence like every other plugin route). Client half registers a
# dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders the aggregate.
- insert:
    - id: usage-replay
      name: dsh-usage-replay

readme.text:
[中文](README.zh.md) | English

Cross-session **per-model token usage** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): a usage panel tab, a per-conversation per-model popover, and two local read-only HTTP routes. Every number is replayed from the harness's own persisted session logs — nothing is accounted in a side channel, so uninstalling never loses data and history predating this plugin counts too.

**Tokens only.** No cost estimates, no price tables, no network calls.
**Usage panel tab** (needs [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) ≥ 0.28): register a `用量 / Usage` tab in the right sidebar.

- **Models** — per provider/model: sessions, requests, uncached input, output, cache read, cache write, total.
- **By day** — last 30 days. Toggle **stacked bars ⇄ per-model smooth curves**; hover for an immediate tooltip (date · day total · per-model rows). The curve view y-scales to the largest single-model day so the highest line reaches the plot top. **Log-scale** toggle for long-tail data (a single huge day otherwise flattens everything else). Bars stack by real token share.
- **Workspaces** — usage ranked by session `cwd`, with each workspace's model mix.

**Composer-dock pill** — a neutral `分模型 / Per-model` chip next to the native activity/usage pills; click to open this conversation's per-model table (model / requests / input / output / cache read / cache write / total). No duplicated totals in the dock row.

The native changed-files card summarizes each turn from git working-tree snapshots, so in a workspace shared by several sessions (or edited by a running watcher) it can list files this conversation never touched. Enabling `sessionScopedEdits: true` narrows that card to the files this conversation's file tools actually touched in the turn:

- Tracks `fs/write-intent` / `fs/edit-intent` per session and turn (the same events the recorder itself uses) and filters the `workspaceChanges` service summary in place, remapping per-file diff indexes so the card UI keeps working unchanged. Reversible on unload; turns the plugin did not observe fall back to the native summary.
- Subagent file-tool edits count for the parent conversation's turn.
- Trade-off: files changed **only** through shell commands are not attributed and stay hidden while this option is on.

Off by default (it changes another plugin's observable behavior). Enable it in the plugin row config:

```yaml
- id: usage-replay
  config:
    sessionScopedEdits: true
```

- Walks `$DSH_HOME/sessions` (default `~/.dsh/sessions`) for `session[.vN].jsonl[.zstd]` artifacts, decodes the multi-frame Zstandard container frame by frame (torn tail tolerated), and folds `assistant/message` usage events into the provider/model of the most recent `request/header` envelope.
- Applies to the whole session log (not the visible/compacted window), so pruned or compacted turns still count.
- Results cached per file by `size + mtime`; unchanged files are never re-read.
- Retries/attempts count where the provider reported usage — the same billing-shaped semantics as the official token meter.

- Reads local session logs only. **No network requests, no telemetry, no uploads.**
- Routes: `GET /usage-replay/api/summary`, `GET /usage-replay/api/session?sessionId=…` — loopback/trusted-host admission through the host's Connection service, same fence as every other plugin route. Nothing sensitive is returned beyond per-model token numbers.
- The plugin adds no model-visible prompt, tool, or schema.

readme.section: from the community market (dsh-market) or npm

readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/Eclipse-NotFound/dsh-usage-replay
```

Desktop app profiles are managed by the app: install from its **Plugins** page with the package path/spec instead of the CLI. A new host half needs an app restart; client-only updates apply after a hard refresh.

`dsh-better-sidebar` is an optional peer: without it the sidebar tab is not registered and the composer-dock pill still works.

No dependencies, no build step. Node 22.19+ / 24 (host runtime) is enough.

```sh
node test/offline-check.mjs   # self-contained: synthetic multi-frame zstd logs + route checks
```
